text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Syrian newspapers on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- President Hazez al-Assad returns home after successful prostate surgery; receives phone calls from Saudi Arabian King Fahd, Saudi Crown Prince abdullah and Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak who wished him speedy recovery.
- World continues condemnation of the criminal bombing of a bus in Damascus.
- Vice-President Abdel-Halim Khaddam and Foreign Minister Farouq al-Shara meet Lebanon's Foreign Minister Faris Bouez for discussion of regional developments and bilateral cooperation.
- Israel escalates its aggressions against south Lebanon. Lebanese resistance replies by attacking two Israeli enemy army positions.
- Egyptian President Mubarak: "Collpase of the Middle East peace process will open the door for destructive operations which will cover the whole world."
- French President Jacques Chirac calls for freeze on Jewish settlements in Israeli-occupied Arab lands.
- Arab League calls on Israel to implement agreemnets which it signed with Arabs.
- Israeli occupation forces arrest a number of Syrians in the Golan.
- Egyptian parties open conference in Cairo in solidarity with Syria.
